text: 上海第八批次出让的两宗（涉）住宅地块成功出让，成交总额156.01亿元，总面积约13.85万平方米，规划建筑面积约42.02万平方米。本批次共有5位竞买人（共涉及10家房企）参与竞买。
text_en: Two (involving) residential land plots in Shanghai's eighth batch were successfully sold, with a total transaction amount of 15.601 billion yuan, a total area of about 138,500 square meters, and planned construction area of about 420,200 square meters. A total of 5 bidders (involving 10 real estate enterprises) participated in this batch.
